fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique node identifier used for identity and lookup. Requirements: lowercase_snake_case, immutable once created, globally unique within the graph.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable display name shown in the UI. Can include spaces and capitalization; not used for identity.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Node taxonomy; must match one of nodeTypes[].name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional free-text context or rationale not modeled as separate nodes; prefer structured graph facts when possible.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Where the node belongs, in independent dimensions: dimension:values groups separated by semicolons, for example bu:uc,nc;module:sbd. A dimension left out is not stated.
guidance: A business-unit specific concept (a screen, section, field, rule, or process of one unit) gets the unit as a name prefix and as its bu scope, for example NODE_CREATE|uc_qde_screen|QDE Screen|screen||bu:uc|. Keep the prefix out of the label.

The same concept in two units is two different nodes (uc_qde_screen and nc_qde_screen). Reuse another unit's node only when the input explicitly refers to that unit's item; otherwise create or reuse the selected unit's own node.

Shared technical artefacts (Apex classes, Aura and LWC components, flows, objects, custom metadata, labels, settings, APIs) keep their exact API name without a prefix. Leave bu out unless the input states which units use them.
An item owned by a horizontal module team (SBD, HZT, Mandate, PAI) gets the module dimension (module:sbd) and no name prefix; add bu only for the units the input names.

dimensions.name: bu
dimensions.label: Business unit
dimensions.description: Business units the node applies to, for example bu:uc or bu:uc,nc. Set it for business-unit specific concepts and when the input states which units use the node; list every unit it applies to (there is no value for all units). Leave it out when that is not known.

dimensions.name: module
dimensions.label: Module
dimensions.description: Horizontal module team that owns the node (SBD, HZT, Mandate, PAI), for example module:sbd. Independent of bu: set it when the input says a module team owns or builds the item.

fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Source node name. Must reference an existing node; immutable for relation identity.

fields.name: targetName
fields.description: Target node name. Must reference an existing node; immutable for relation identity.

fields.name: relation
fields.description: Relation type; must match one of relationshipTypes[].name. Part of relation identity; use lowercase_snake_case.

fields.name: information
fields.description: Single-line contextual note about the relationship (e.g., 'on click of Next button'). Use for UX/state/transport details clarifying the link.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional longer rationale or operational notes about the relation; use sparingly.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Where the relation belongs, same syntax as node scope. Empty in almost all cases.
guidance: A relation that touches a unit-specific node already belongs to that unit, so never repeat the unit on the relation. Set relation bu only when both endpoints state no business unit and the input says the relation exists only for some units.

dimensions.name: bu
dimensions.label: Business unit
dimensions.description: Business units the relation applies to. Leave it out in almost all cases: a relation touching a unit-specific node already belongs to that unit. Set it only when both endpoints state no business unit and the input says the relation exists only for some units.

dimensions.name: module
dimensions.label: Module
dimensions.description: Horizontal module team the relation belongs to. Leave it out in almost all cases.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Optional machine-readable flags used by the ingestion engine (e.g., 'AMBIGUITY:<reason>', 'CONTRADICTION:<reason>').
